description:
Fetch a ClickUp/Linear/GitHub ticket URL, summarize into a work-brief: goal, acceptance criteria, blast radius, suggested branch name, suggested commit prefix, related repos.
Trigger this skill when: - User pastes a `*.clickup.com/t/…` URL. - User pastes a `linear.app/…/issue/…` URL. - User pastes a `github.com/*/issues/…` or `pull/…` URL. - User says "brief this ticket", "summarize this issue", or invokes
  `/ticket-brief`.
